Hi Maria —

Attached is the canonical export and a short SCCs-summary that maps our transfer mechanisms by vendor. Quick highlights here to save time:
- Primary compute for EU-region customers is provisioned in eu-west-1 (GCP and AWS depending on model variant). EU customer data is pinned to EU regions unless the customer opts into cross-region replication.
- We use EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for vendor relationships where required; the attached SCCs-summary lists which vendors are covered and the enforcement dates.
- Recent additions (within last 90 days): FastEdge CDN (added 2026-08-12) — used for static assets and model artifacts; LogsBackupCo (added 2026-09-03) — used for long-term encrypted backups stored in us-central1.
- Backups: operational backups are encrypted at rest; LogsBackupCo processes encrypted backups and maintains a 90-day retention by default (configurable per-customer).

I've also included a short note on the deletion workflow — we support customer-initiated data deletion and retention overrides via the Console; when customers request export/deletion we coordinate with subprocessors to purge their copies within contractual windows.

Attachments: SCCs-summary-20261029.pdf, redwood-subprocessors-20261028.csv (canonical export, 2.1 KB)

If you want we can set up a 20-30 minute call next week to walk through FastEdge's role and the safeguards we have in place.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

From: EcomPlus Legal <legal@ecomplus.com>

Subject: Follow-up: FastEdge CDN and backup provider questions

Hi Mina / Marcus —

Thanks for the materials so far. A couple of follow-ups from Legal after a quick review:
1) FastEdge: we see it listed as a CDN added 2026-08-12. Can you confirm whether FastEdge receives any customer message content or only static artifacts and model weights? If it receives any content, please confirm the contractual transfer mechanism and whether processing occurs outside the EU for EU customers.

2) LogsBackupCo: please confirm the encryption model (customer-unique keys vs system keys) and whether copies are geo-replicated to the US by default for EU customers. If geo-replication to US is automatic, we need to know if customers can opt out.

3) Notification windows: your DPA calls out 30 days' notice for subprocessor additions. Can you confirm the timeline applied to FastEdge and provide the change-log entries for Q3 so we can reconcile with our procurement timeline?

We may request a limited redline to the DPA around notification windows depending on answers.

Regards,
EcomPlus Legal
legal@ecomplus.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Bcc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 17:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: FastEdge CDN and backup provider questions

Hi —

Quick update based on internal checks (short answers up front):
- FastEdge receives only static assets and model artifact distribution; it does not receive customer message content or prompt texts. Processing for EU customers is routed to FastEdge's EU POPs and does not send payloads to non-EU cores by default.
- LogsBackupCo uses system-managed keys by default; customers can request customer-managed keys for backups via our enterprise plan. Geo-replication to the US is enabled for redundancy but can be disabled per-account for EU-only residency (we expose this toggle for Dedicated/Private customers and can apply a contract addendum for hosted customers).
- Notification: FastEdge was added on 2026-08-12 and we posted a subprocessor notice internally then. Our standard DPA notification window is 30 days for major changes; for FastEdge we triggered email notice to contracted customers on 2026-08-15.

I've attached the change log exports for Q3 and a pointer to the SOC2 request portal where you can request a limited-scope SOC 2 Type II package. If you prefer, Mina and I can take a 25-minute call Wed (04 Nov) or Thu to review the items and capture any redline requests.

Attachments: subprocessor-change-log-2026Q3.xlsx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-ecomplus-subprocessors, https://redwood-internal.company/soc2-portal/request/EC-789
